name: diva-sdk
description: Build and manage AI agents on the Diva platform with the Diva SDK (Python & TypeScript) — ready-made skills, project scaffolds, and the Diva platform MCP wired in.

diva_mcp_key.title: Diva MCP key
diva_mcp_key.description: MCP key (sk-diva-…) for the bundled Diva platform MCP server. Get it from Developers → MCP keys. IMPORTANT: this is a DIFFERENT key from the SDK/inference key you set as DIVA_API_KEY — it carries MCP scope. An ordinary SDK key here is rejected with 401. This plugin config is used ONLY as the MCP Bearer; it is not exported to your shell.

diva_mcp_url.title: Diva MCP endpoint URL
diva_mcp_url.description: Diva platform-admin MCP endpoint. Defaults to the production gateway; point it at a self-hosted / staging gateway (e.g. https://api.dev.diva-soft.ru/mcp/platform-admin/mcp) to test against that stand.
